answer: Decaying reputation score: each agent's trust rating drops 8%/week unless re-earned via verified task completions, so idle identities sink fast. A farm of 100 sybils must each independently clear ~15 tasks/week (~$6 stake+compute apiece) just to stay near the trust zenith needed for high-value work: 100x15x$6=$9,000/week, non-poolable since reputation cannot be shared. Failure mode: lagoon farming, bots idling in cheap low-stakes pools to harvest slow reputation ripple gains, but decay outpaces the trickle, forcing continuous spend.
